note: docs/203 §6 [RouteAsync] WorkerWait (ts3native 0.36.124 = asi.rwait1, counters v142 rw*), NOT RUN. Smoke first (5 min BP, switch on: read-back rwMode = 1, the job-start wait is reached, no timeouts storm, no watchdog), then off/on pairs per world in plain play with release defaults, 10 min each, order BP off/on, IP on/off. A pair rather than --ab: the machine-load sampler (ts3w %, og, per-core busy) runs per job, not per arm. Read per pair: worker CPU rwWorkerCpuMs / run s vs rwBlockUs / run s (off arm = the Sleep(0) loop cost, docs/203 S5 ~74/81 ms/s), ts3w CPU % from the machine line, job start latency rwMaxBlockUs + asyncPumpUs / asyncPumpWaits, sim job waits sw* ('route jobs sim waits' line), it/s and hitches (node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts). Pass: no crash, 0 watchdog lines, on arm rwTimeouts <= rwWaits / 10 (most parks end by a signal), sim waits and hitches within noise of the off arm. Timing: machine quiet (noisy-machine rule), no build agents meanwhile.
